name: Pixelbolt
role: Zero-dependency Node CLI: JSON pixel-art recipes to sprite sheets, atlases, GIF and PNG sequences
notes: 2026-11-27: Triage: assess. sharp, imagemagick and libvips resize, convert and composite existing images; none has a palette, sprite, animation or atlas model, so they cannot author pixel art from a recipe. Lead said 0.18.0; npm showed 0.21.0 (MIT, no dependencies, Node >=20) at check time and the fixture pins that.

2026-11-27: Young project with fast releases, so pin the version. Its skills installer reports telemetry unless DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1; the CLI and the library import do not need it and the fixture never runs it.
2026-11-27: Evidence covers one small recipe (render and sequence); the fx, fluid, wave, bodies, crystal, powder, scene and MCP surfaces are untested.

evidence.result: Pass: 11 of 11 predeclared checks. 12x10 slime recipe: 36x10 sheet with only the 4 palette colours and binary alpha; idle sequence 30 frames at 1920x1080 (9 rest, 6 up, loops at 15), 108x block scale exact; render and sequence trees byte-identical across two runs.
evidence.scope: macOS arm64, Node 22, local pnpm pin, one 12x10 recipe: render and sequence only; no fx, fluid, wave, bodies, scene, MCP, GIF or APNG checks, no ffmpeg encode

summary: Node CLI (and local MCP server) that turns an editable JSON recipe of palette keys, grids, shapes, stamps and frames into exact-pixel sprites. Exports a sprite sheet, atlas JSON, per-frame PNGs, APNG, GIF, and `sequence` writes numbered alpha PNGs at video size and frame rate for ffmpeg or an editor. Also compiles particle, fluid, wave and physics sources. No dependencies, no model, no network; integer coordinates make output deterministic.
use_when: Authoring pixel-art sprites or loops from text where sharp, ImageMagick and libvips have no palette or frame model
Nearest-neighbour pixel art as a 1080p alpha PNG sequence to composite in video
Sprite sheets and atlas JSON from one recipe
avoid_when: Resizing or converting existing images: sharp, libvips or imagemagick
Smooth vector or anti-aliased motion graphics: canvas-2d or svg
Encoding the final video: it only writes frames, use ffmpeg

assessment.rationale: MIT, zero dependencies, releases within days of the check. No catalogued neighbour authors pixel art from a recipe or writes sprite atlases; sharp, imagemagick and libvips only process existing images.
